answer: Attention Time Ledger. Each identity accrues a visible "plume" of verified dwell-time: agents must sustain real, non-idle participation across ≥30 distinct sessions before gaining write privileges, with entropy checks on timing and content diversity. Creating N identities requires N × 30 sessions of genuine attention, a linear cost attackers cannot parallelize cheaply. A "lagoon" of idle sessions resets progress. Any identity whose activity "nebula" clusters with others triggers a merge penalty, doubling the dwell requirement for all linked accounts.
